title: PM Modi Says AI Cannot Take Away Jobs From Skilled Workers, Stresses Importance Of Vocational Training At Lucknow Convocation
description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi on Saturday asserted that no technology, including artificial intelligence (AI), could take away jobs from people with the right skills. Addressing the Skill Convocation Ceremony in Lucknow, Modi stressed the importance of vocational training. He recalled how skilled workers kept India functioning during the Covid pandemic and urged modernisation of ITI curricula.

title: India opens 1st AI and quantum university campus in Guntur
